content.text: I used to be a pescatarian before, which basically means you don't eat meat, but still have fish
content.trans: 英语：我以前是个素食主义者，也就是不吃肉，但还是吃鱼。

content.text: and seafood.
content.trans: 和海鲜。

content.text: Wow.
content.trans: 英语：Wow.

content.text: That's interesting.
content.trans: 这很有趣。

content.text: It must be tough.
content.trans: 英语：它必须是困难的。

content.text: It's a bit difficult to find vegetarian-friendly restaurants sometimes, but since more and more
content.trans: 英语：它有时很难找到素食友好餐馆，但自从越来越多的餐厅开始提供素食选项以来，情况有所改善。

content.text: people are vegetarians or vegans nowadays, it's getting a bit less difficult.
content.trans: 现在，人们越来越倾向于素食或无肉主义。这使得事情变得更容易了。

content.text: All right.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: So talking about vegan vegetarians, pescatarians, it seems like these diets or these lifestyles
content.trans: 英语：所以谈论素食主义者、肉食者，似乎这些饮食或生活方式。

content.text: are more and more popular, but as we saw in the dialogue, it can be a little bit difficult,
content.trans: 英语：它越来越受欢迎，但正如对话中所见，它可能有点困难。

content.text: especially in maybe countries where it's not so popular to have these diets.
content.trans: 特别在一些不太可能有这些饮食习惯的国家。

content.text: Definitely.
content.trans: 当然。

content.text: I think that in places where you can find vegan and vegetarian products very easily, being
content.trans: 我感觉在容易找到素食和无动物产品的地方，选择这个选项。

content.text: a vegetarian becomes much more easy because you have more options.
content.trans: 这个素食主义者变得更容易是因为你有更多的选择。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 正确。以下是该短语在中文中的翻译：

content.text: But if you're living in a country where it's very hard to eat a meal without having meat,
content.trans: 但是如果你身处一个非常难吃的食物中，比如在非洲或中东地区，那么你可能需要携带一些特殊的食品存储设备。例如，你可以带上一个专门的袋子来储存肉类，或者使用一些特殊的设计来防止食物变质。

content.text: then you might just eat potatoes every day and that will get very, very difficult and
content.trans: 然后你可能每天吃土豆，那会变得非常困难。

content.text: very boring.
content.trans: 很无聊。

content.text: Well, that's one of the main arguments or the main concerns with people is that even
content.trans: 嗯，这也是人们讨论的一个主要论点或关注点。

content.text: though you can argue that you can get all the vitamins or many of the vitamins and minerals
content.trans: 虽然你可以说你能够获得所有的维生素或许多的维生素和矿物质，但这是不正确的。

content.text: from nuts and from vegetables, it's still not healthy to completely exclude from your
content.trans: 从坚果和蔬菜中，它仍然不能完全排除你的健康。

content.text: diet, maybe sources of proteins like meat or eggs or dairy products.
content.trans: 饮食，或许来源蛋白质如肉类、鸡蛋或奶制品。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: And so in America, for example, it's very easy to find supplements.
content.trans: 而且在美国，比如，很容易找到补充剂。

content.text: You can take vitamins like calcium and you can have pills that will give you some protein
content.trans: 你可以在钙片和蛋白粉之间选择。

content.text: and you can find all sorts of exotic vegetables that will help you supplement your diet.
content.trans: 英语：和你找到各种各样的异国蔬菜，这些蔬菜将帮助你补充你的饮食。

content.text: But in a place like trying to, for example, I think it can be a lot harder to find those
content.trans: 但是，在比如，我认为在寻找这些方面可能会更难。

content.text: products and to find those supplements.
content.trans: 产品和找到那些补充品。

content.text: And so being a vegan, especially or a vegetarian poses a lot more challenges.
content.trans: 而且，尤其是素食者，特别是或完全素食者，面临着更多的挑战。

content.text: Especially, I think with what you mentioned that products are usually labeled where they
content.trans: 特别地，我认为你提到的产品通常被标示在哪里。

content.text: tell you if they have any animal-based products in there.
content.trans: 英语：告诉你们里面有没有动物产品。

content.text: Whereas in other countries, it's probably not labeled and it's a little bit, even things
content.trans: 英语：在其他国家，它很可能是不标注的，并且有点小。

content.text: like getting the fat-free things are a little bit more difficult in other countries like,
content.trans: 英语：比如，其他国家在处理脂肪含量方面比这里容易一些。

content.text: for example, China.
content.trans: 例如，中国。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: So we would like to know are there many vegans or vegetarians in your country?
content.trans: 英语：所以我们想了解一下你的国家里有多少素食者或素食主义者。

content.text: And if there are, do you think it's hard for them to buy food?
content.trans: 如果他们有，那么他们是否容易买食物？

content.text: Why, why not?
content.trans: 英语：为什么，为什么不？

content.text: Let us know.
content.trans: 英语：让我们知道。

content.text: Our website is englispod.com.
content.trans: 我们的网站是英语学习网。

content.text: Alright, we'll see you guys there.
content.trans: 好的，我们见你了。

content.text: Bye.
content.trans: 英语：再见。

content.text: Bye.
content.trans: 拜。
